div.head: II As 13
div.ab: Be burga gebettunge. We cwædon, þæt ælc burgh sy gebet feowertyne niht ofer gangdagas.
Ond we cweðaþ, ðæt ælc burh sy gebet XIIII niht ofer gongdagas.
[Be burhbot.] ⁊ we cwædon, þæt ælc burh sie gebet feowertyne niht ofer gangdagas.
Quo termino burga debent refici. Instituimus, ut omne burgum refectum sit XIIII noctibus supra Rogationes.
[Be burga gebettunge.] [Ld] Ond we cwæðaþ, ðæt ælc burh sy gebet XIIII niht ofer gongdagas.
And we declare that every fortress shall be repaired by a fortnight after Rogation days.
And we pronounce that every borough is to be repaired by a fortnight after Rogation days.
(Über Herstellung der Burgen. So Ld) Und wir bestimmten (-men H), dass jede Burg 14 Tage nach den Bittgangtagen hergerichtet sei.
(On the repair of fortresses. So Ld) And we determined (determine, H) that every fortified town be repaired a fortnight after the Rogation days.
